summary: Iteration 18 validated. Items page now exposes exactly 5 categories (entry, food, activities, dress, others) with correct labels & auto GST mapping to (activity/food/activity/clothing/other). Packages Add dialog shows 3 toolbar buttons (Pick from Items, Auto-fill, Blank line). Picker dialog opens, groups items by 5 categories, items are clickable and add rows with correct label + mapped GST category + item's offer_price/price. Toast 'Added <name>' appears. Sum badge updates. Backend accepts all 5 category values and package with derived gst_split persists correctly.

issues: Console hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' — coming from the visual-editor instrumentation wrapping {c.label} inside <option> elements in the GST-category <select>. Not a functional bug and does not affect prod build, but noisy in console. If needed, wrap the label render as a plain string (already is c.label) — the wrapper span is injected by the emergent instrumentation, so ignore unless customer sees it.

critical_code_review_comments: Games.jsx keeps legacy category themes (Adventure/Water/Ride/etc.) as fallback — good, avoids visual regression for pre-existing items.

Packages.jsx addItemToSplit correctly maps item.category (entry/food/activities/dress/others) → backend GST enum (activity/food/activity/clothing/other) via ITEM_TO_GST. Falls back to item.gst_category if category is unknown (safe).

Note: FUNLAND_DEFAULTS seed (lines 54-67 Games.jsx) still uses legacy categories (Adventure/Ride/Water/Games). If admin uses 'Load Funland defaults', those items will NOT appear in the package picker (picker filters by 5 new categories). Consider migrating defaults to the new 5-category taxonomy OR let picker include legacy categories under 'Others'.

success_rate.backend: 100% (4/4 relevant tests; 1 skipped due to bills schema out-of-scope)

seed_data_creation: Created 2 UI items (TEST_ITER18_UI_food, TEST_ITER18_UI_act) — cleaned up after test. Backend tests create/delete TEST_ITER18_* items per run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iter18 acceptance criteria pass. FUNLAND_DEFAULTS seed uses legacy category strings — if picker coverage is important for a fresh install, migrate defaults to new 5-cat taxonomy. Bill-from-package end-to-end skipped (POST /api/bills schema differs from what test tried); reports GET endpoints returned 200/404 gracefully.
